2933.title: Inline file citations remain literal in Markdown output
2933.rootCauseOneLine: The Markdown transformer restores every text directive before it checks the directive registry.
2933.proposedFix: Select a provider normalization or an explicit inline directive contract, then preserve file provenance in the chosen display.
2933.caveats: The deterministic renderer path was verified. A live Codex turn and private search data were not used.
